optimizedDescription.value: Defines immutable graph nodes, analysis facts, logical symbols, member semantics, bindings, coverage, and deterministic relations.

optimizedContext.value:
# Symbol Model

## Rules
- `FileNode.path` canonical `{workspace}:{relativeToCodeRoot}`, forward-slash; `configRelativePath` config-root-relative and may contain `..`; plus language/hash/workspace, deferred embedding. Equality by canonical path.
- `SpecNode` identity `specId`; metadata title/description/dependsOn defaults; content/hash concatenate `spec.md` then other artifacts alphabetically, excluding metadata. `DocumentNode` searchable non-code with workspace-qualified identity.
- `SymbolNode.id` remains deterministic location occurrence (`filePath + kind + name + line + column`); complete half-open construct range uses 1-based lines/0-based columns and contains exact-name `selectionRange`; line/column alias construct start.
- All Specs/Files/Symbols/Documents use workspace-qualified canonical primary identities.
- Immutable compact `FileAnalysisDraft`/`FileAnalysis` contain symbols, imports, bindings, calls, namespace context, normalized metadata, optional plain `ParserState`/`AdapterSessionState`; never retain AST/parser objects. `IndexSession`/`SymbolIndex` provide bounded file/symbol/spec/document/coverage lookup and relation dedup.
- Closed `SymbolKind`: `function`, `class`, `method`, `variable`, `type`, `interface`, `enum`.
- Closed relations: `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. Relation equality = source/target/type; `metadata.stale` applies to unresolved `COVERS_SYMBOL`, not generic materialization failure.
- `ImportDeclaration`: local/original/specifier/relative plus optional `named|namespace|default|side-effect|dynamic|require|blank`; undefined means named. File-only forms use empty names and create no fake symbol.
- Immutable scoped facts model scope ownership, binding sources, calls, deterministic reason/diagnostics. Parent-scope cycles abort lookup. Emit only deterministic persisted relations; drop self-relations and speculative facts.
- Distinguish declaration occurrences from logical symbols; language-defined overload/merge may share logical identity, competing declarations remain distinct.
- Logical symbol structured authority: workspace, surface, `declaringOwner`, symbol space, simple name, `MemberSemantics`, versioned delimiter-safe escaped canonical reference. Canonical reference includes semantic axes, survives location movement, round-trips, never uses human `.`/`::`; retired member-form encoding is invalid current ID.
- Owned logical symbol stores exact `qualified_name` as dotted owner chain + simple name; top-level omits it. `::` query compares to same spelling. Qualified name is not canonical ID, alias row, simple-name replacement, or FTS exact store.
- Logical symbols carry no package name. Workspace plus adapter package map owns package identity. `SymbolKind` remains broad; namespace/module is owner-path role/surface.
- `declaringOwner` is canonical logical identity of syntactic owner, never parser/location/display ID. Adapter emits declaration `parentId`; shared model has no language list. Same-name members under different owners differ; movement within owner preserves canonical reference.
- `MemberSemantics` jointly represents `kind`, `dispatch`, `accessor`, optional proven `nativeKind`. No `MemberForm` in logical symbols, resolver inputs, store lookups, or persistence. Preserve language-specific type/value/namespace/module/property spaces and case rules; never globally lowercase or collapse differing semantic axes.
- Public slot lookup uses surface + exported name + symbol space. Each proven route has independent binding identity distinguishing target or ordered re-export provenance. Binding surface is exporter; target may be cross-workspace; never first same-name guess. Local binding preserves lexical scope/range. Aliases, shadowing, competing routes/targets never collapse through relation equality; generic/native spellings are rendered, not alias rows.
- Persist per-file/package coverage: indexed, excluded, unsupported adapter/capability, parse-failed, partial, plus indexed content hash establishing trustworthy absence.
- All model properties readonly; mutations occur only via atomic `GraphStore` replacement.
- Errors derive `SpecdCodeGraphError extends SpecdError`: invalid symbol/relation, duplicate ID, closed store.

## Constraints
- Value-object structural equality except deterministic `SymbolNode.id`.
- `SymbolKind` and `RelationType` changes require spec change.
- Runtime dependency on `@specd/core`; errors follow Specd Error Contract.
- No reflection, runtime containers, interprocedural or whole-program inference.
- `embedding` deferred v2+; `COVERS_*` vocabulary deferred v2+ population; `DEPENDS_ON` indexed from spec metadata/content; `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, hierarchy relations first-class v2.
